finding: Historical Forge candidate source_count incremented before candidate_sources INSERT OR IGNORE, so exact replay of an already-admitted provenance tuple could inflate scheduling weight without creating a new canonical provenance link.
hypothesis: If source_count is incremented only when candidate_sources admits a new primary-key tuple, identical replay becomes +0 while genuinely distinct provenance remains +1.
counterhypothesis: source_count may intentionally count processing attempts rather than admitted provenance observations.
counterhypothesis_resolution: Rejected for the active evidence path because candidate_sources is the durable provenance relation, Supervisor 8.78 forbids historical replay from creating independent evidence by repackaging the same execution, and ready-candidate ordering uses source_count as a scheduling signal.

bounded_delta.behavior: candidate_sources is attempted first; existing candidates increment source_count by exactly int(new_provenance_link_admitted). Identical provenance replay therefore adds zero scheduling weight.

test_design.identical_replay: same variant + same source_event_id + same chunk_id + same extractor_worker_sha + same extraction_mode => source_count remains 1 and candidate_sources remains 1
test_design.distinct_provenance: same variant + distinct source_event_id => source_count becomes 2; replay of that second link remains +0

track_a: ADVANCED_SOURCE_SCOPE: prevents replay-amplified Forge scheduling weight on the historical conversion path.
track_b: ADVANCED_CAUSAL_PROVENANCE_SCOPE: source_count now tracks admission of the canonical provenance relation rather than processing attempts, strengthening Typed Entry / causal identity reuse semantics without adding a second authority.
track_c: ADVANCED_TRAINING_READINESS_SOURCE_SCOPE: historical replay cannot inflate candidate prioritization merely by reprocessing one provenance tuple, reducing a leakage/pseudo-evidence path before Distillery/J-Space dataset promotion.
next_exact_gate: Execute tests/test_free_swarm_source_count_idempotency_878.py together with the existing historical-backfill suite on exact-current main inside the authorized zero-cost runtime, then run the singleton full-history saturation dispatch and verify second-pass replay adds zero source_count scheduling weight and zero duplicate provenance links.
